info.name: Catchpoint REST API v2.0 Account SLO API
Retrieve properties of one or more SLOs based on SLO IDs.

params.name: sloIds
params.description: A comma-separated list of SLO IDs to look up.

items.docs: Multiple SLO IDs may be included in a comma-separated list.

info.name: Update properties of an existing SLO based on the request body.

params.name: sloIds
params.description: A comma delimited list of SLO IDs to update an SLO.

params.name: objectDetails
params.description: Retrieves object details after update.

items.docs:
**Request:**
            
Only the property to be updated can be passed in the request body instead of the whole object. The update request body requires a total of three keys to be filled with appropriate value as listed below:
* **value** – The value property provides the new value.

info.name: Delete one or more SLOs based on SLO IDs.

params.name: sloIds
params.description: A comma-separated list of SLO IDs to delete.

items.docs:
This endpoint allows partial success.
For example, if the request includes a list of five SLO IDs but only three of them match existing SLOs, then those three SLOs will be deleted and indicated as such in the response.
The two invalid SLO IDs will be listed in the response with an error message.

info.name: Retrieve SLOs that match all included parameters.

params.name: statusType
params.description: The SLO status ID. “0” for Active, “1” for inactive.

params.name: sloName
params.description: An SLO name.

params.name: testName
params.description: A Test name assigned to the SLOs to look up.

params.name: metricType
params.description: The SLO metric ID. “15” for Availability, “89” for Test Time.

params.name: testIds
params.description: A comma-separated list of Test IDs assigned to the SLOs to look up.

params.name: divisionId
params.description: The Division ID of the SLOs to look up. If left empty, the default division of the API user will be used.

items.docs: All parameters are optional, and if no parameters are provided then details for all active SLOs are returned.

info.name: Create a new SLO configured per the request body.

params.name: objectDetails
params.description: Retrieves object details after creating it.

items.docs:
The request body must include all required SLO properties, and may include any optional properties as well.
To get a sample payload to pass along with the request, use the response from endpoint GET: /api/v2/slo/{sloIds} with {sloIds} as “0”.

params.name: analyticsMetric
params.description: Return analyticsMetric enumeration

params.name: domainStatus
params.description: Return domainStatus enumeration

params.name: nodeThresholdType
params.description: Return nodeThresholdType enumeration

params.name: operatorType
params.description: Return operatorType enumeration

items.docs: All parameters are optional, and if no parameters are provided then all enumerations are returned.
